description:
Fix code quality issues in the 'InventoryManager' project using Eclipse's 'Source > Clean Up' feature and manual corrections.

The project contains several code smells:
- Missing @Override annotations
- Unused imports
- Raw type usage (e.g., List instead of List<String>)
- Unnecessary boxing (e.g., Integer.valueOf(42))
- String comparison using '==' instead of '.equals()'

Your task:
1. Open the 'InventoryManager' project in Eclipse (it is already in the workspace).
2. Open the Problems view to see the warnings.
3. Use 'Source > Clean Up...' on the project to fix standard issues (missing @Override, unused imports, unnecessary boxing).
4. Manually fix any remaining issues, specifically replacing '==' with '.equals()' for String comparisons and fixing raw types.
5. Ensure the project compiles with ZERO errors and ZERO warnings (verify in Problems view).
6. Save all files.
